card.name: Punctuation after a drug name in lists
card.fires_on: The comma after a drug name inside a chemotherapy regimen list, or the word 'was' right after a drug name in animal-study fetal harm statements.

modes.label: Comma in regimen list
modes.description: Comma following a drug name in a multi-drug combination regimen.

modes.label: Drug name then 'was'
modes.description: The word 'was' following a drug name in animal embryo-fetal toxicity findings.
modes.example: Binimetinib<< was>> embryotoxic and abortifacient when

modes.label: Space before dose number
modes.description: The space after 'is' just before a dactinomycin dose amount.
modes.example: combination chemotherapy regimen, is<< >>45 mcg/kg intravenously

card.plain: It fires on the small joining spot right after a drug name, such as a comma in a regimen list or 'was' in an animal study sentence.
